_howto: Per-video TikTok playCount ledger, one block per creator.
WHY: the public embed endpoint (tiktok.com/embed/@handle) only returns the
~12 NEWEST videos. Summing just those undercounts any creator whose older
posts carry real views - @freewillflow's single biggest video (690K) sits
well outside that window, so the embed-only total reported 3% of reality.
HOW: refresh-stats.mjs updates the ids it can currently see and keeps the
last known count for the rest, so the total covers the whole catalogue and
can never regress when a video ages out of the window.
Seeded 2026-08-19 from each creator's public profile grid. To reseed, open
the profile logged in, sort by Popular, scroll to the end and read the
per-tile counts (docs/backfill/README.md describes the same technique).
